## Stock Lot

One FIFO cost layer. A lot records `sku`, `lot`, the `received` date (YYYY-MM-DD, which sets FIFO order), the inventory `asset` account it sits in, its `source` (the bill, roast batch or opening balances it came from), the received `qty` (thousandths of a unit) and `costMinor` (as received, before landed cost).

Its remaining cost is kept split by cost account: `part5000Minor` (green coffee and roasting) and `part5100Minor` (packaging). `consumedQty` grows with each draw and `landedMinor` with each landed-cost addition; `retiredBy` names the reversal that undid the roast that made the lot. Computed fields: `remainingQty` (`qty − consumedQty`) and `remainingCostMinor` (`part5000Minor + part5100Minor`).

Only the lot's own operations change it. Each is sent in the same batch as the document that needs it, so the document and the lot land together or not at all.

### Operations
- `draw` takes `qty` out at the lot's own rate (remaining cost × quantity ÷ remaining quantity, rounded); refuses a non-positive quantity, an overdraw, a cost off that rate, a negative split, a split that doesn't add up to `costMinor`, or more of a cost account than the lot has left.
- `restore` puts back a draw's quantity and cost when its posting is reversed; refuses to put back more than was drawn, or to restore into a retired lot.
- `addCost` adds landed cost to `part5000Minor` and `landedMinor`; refuses a non-positive amount or a lot with no stock left.
- `removeCost` takes landed cost back off when a landed-cost posting is reversed; refuses more than the lot carries.
- `retire` empties a lot a roast made when that roast is reversed, stamping `retiredBy`; refuses once any of it has been used or if it is already retired.

Which lots to draw (oldest first) is chosen by whoever enters the document; the lot only checks each draw against itself.

```ts
import { StockLot } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-stock';

@field lots = linksToMany(() => StockLot, { query: { page: { size: 1000 } } });
```

### Non-goals
No automatic FIFO selection, no weighted-average or standard costing, and no warehouse bin or location tracking.

### Example
`InventoryLot/GRN-COL-HUI-2410_HUI-2026-01`, a received lot of green coffee.
